summary: Farmer Bros. Co. filed an 8-K disclosing receipt of fourteen demand letters and three shareholder lawsuits challenging the adequacy of disclosures in its preliminary and definitive proxy statements for the pending merger with Royal Cup, Inc. The merger, announced March 3, 2026, involves Merger Sub merging with Farmer Bros., which will survive as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Royal Cup. The board believes the claims are meritless and disclosures comply with law, but may provide additional disclosures to mitigate litigation risk and avoid delaying the special meeting scheduled for May 1, 2026. Watch for supplemental filings or court rulings on injunctive relief.
